items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: I'd get back in the trombone section... I'd say Bob, go on out and enjoy yourself. I'd go back and play the trombone book

ctx.x: So, I knew at that time that I could get this right in the mood. That's what I wanted to do. So, I, cause I, back in the Savoy Ballroom, I used to, on our last hour, cause we had to play the hour before closing. I used to go out and say Harwood, you go on out and enjoy yourself." I'd sit down and

play his, his book for an hour. You know, one night, on the baritone sax. And then maybe another night, if I felt like it, I'd get back in the trombone section. That's according to how I felt. I'd say Bob, go on out and enjoy yourself. I'd go back and play the trombone book cause I wanted to keep up on those things at that time.
